name: @sos-2/real-observation
description: SOS 2.0 Real Observation Sources (Work Order P17-C, observation/UX lane): REAL provider adapters feeding the merged P7 Observation Plane. GitHub repository events (webhook-shaped receiver with HMAC validation + REST events-API polling fallback), CI results (GitHub Actions runs per commit), deployment events (Vercel deployments API read directly — no sibling-lane dependency), runtime telemetry (merged W3 TelemetrySource adapters over real HTTP endpoints), scheduled probes (clocked health/quality probes behind the P7 ProbeScheduler) and provider health (real per-provider probes with aggregate honest state). Every source is an EventSourcePort over an INJECTED FetchPort seam — zero ambient network in package src (global fetch binds only at the process boundary); every source reports honest connectivity states (CONNECTED / UNKNOWN / UNAVAILABLE / DEGRADED) from REAL probes, with unprobed sources UNKNOWN and source-down UNAVAILABLE with the real error recorded (never fabricated). All events flow through the merged @sos-2/event-ingestion replay-protected pipeline into the merged @sos-2/observation projections, reconciliation and detection — the plane runs WITHOUT a permanent body (§5). Transcripts are redacted through the merged @sos-2/security secret-shape corpus (names/pattern ids only, never values).

scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run && pnpm --filter @sos-2/web exec vitest run --config live-mission/vitest.config.ts
